people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: For Yahweh has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.
translations.bsb: For the LORD has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.
translations.kjv: For it is the day of the LORD'S vengeance, and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.
